description: Grassroots organizing intensifies among mid-career professionals in law, accounting, and public administration, as AI systems increasingly perform core tasks without human involvement. Local strikes and work-to-rule actions emerge in several member states, demanding recognition of AI-driven displacement and new social protections. The movement remains decentralized but gains traction in national media.

Several EU member states, citing repeated near-misses and insufficient central response, quietly form a regional cyber defence pact outside EU structures, sharing real-time threat telemetry and joint red-teaming exercises. The initiative bypasses stalled EU-wide reforms and reflects growing frustration with Brussels' capacity to deliver resilience.
